2026-09-28-endpoint-catalog-reconciliati.verificationMethod: developer.genesys.cloud, api.mypurecloud.com, help.genesys.cloud, and community.genesys.com are all blocked by this environment's network egress proxy, so no live API Explorer or help-doc fetch was possible this session. Every path/method/response-shape added was instead cross-checked against the full Genesys Cloud OpenAPI (Swagger) spec cached in the repo at GenesysCloudAPIEndpoints.json (key openapi-cache-https---api-mypurecloud-com-api-v2-docs-swagger), and the WorkitemQueryJobResponse.state enum (Queued/Running/Succeeded/Failed) and the deprecation of the old synchronous /api/v2/taskmanagement/workitems/query endpoint were corroborated via WebSearch. All 21 relevant camelCase operationIds (getGroup, getGroupMembers, postGroupsSearch, getAuthorizationSubject, getAuthorizationDivisionGrants, getVoicemailQueueMessages, getVoicemailUserMessages, postTaskmanagementWorkitemsQueryJobs, getTaskmanagementWorkitemsQueryJob, getTaskmanagementWorkitemsQueryJobResults, getTaskmanagementWorkitem, getTaskmanagementWorkitemHistory, getTaskmanagementWorkitemWrapups, getAnalyticsBotflowSessions, getAnalyticsBotflowDivisionsReportingturns, getConversationRecordingAnnotations, getExternalcontactsContact, getExternalcontactsOrganization) were already present in catalog.endpoints from a prior swagger sync; this pass added only the missing curated dataset wrappers and combinations content. Still validationStatus: unvalidated pending a live Track A run against a real org.
